issues: Panel content was a workspace in 12–17px type that became unreadable under perspective
The background was 18 random skewed frames with no spatial relation to the main frame, reading as noise
The 'lift' was a 2D in-plane offset, so there was no real parallax between layers under perspective
The frame trace ran at constant speed with no launch or collision beat
changes: Switched to the aurora look: a violet-to-pink tube built from four stacked strokes (wide halo, mid halo, color core, white-hot core), with two white-hot heads that accelerate and brake around the frame and collide with a flash at the right midpoint
The background is now a 5-layer echo tunnel of the same frame receding in depth; the layers strike on near-to-far once the frame closes and go out middle-first at the end to hand focus to the panel

Components really float in 3D (preserve-3d, translateZ 120–170px) with matching silhouette shadows on the panel, and land in 24f drops staggered sidebar then main area, top to bottom, finishing ~20f after the light-up
The page is a workspace home designed for the lens: a 66px greeting, 84px stat numbers, 31–32px nav and task rows, only 14 parts

The page emerges from black only after the frame closes, then brightens with a cool violet veil receding from the left edge; the camera eases from rotateY −30° to −12° with a long deceleration and keeps drifting 1.5° in the hold; duration 135→140f
